provenance: All assets are generated in this repository. No third-party sample material is incorporated.

sounds.name: SUB PULSE
sounds.role: 49 Hz propulsion with 98/147 Hz translation; short recovery.
sounds.use: Offbeat eighths or quarter notes; velocity 0.55–0.85.
sounds.method: 49 Hz sine, brief pitch fall, harmonic body and filtered contact transient.

sounds.name: MECHANICAL KICK
sounds.role: 68 Hz body, 150–900 Hz mechanism and 2–5 kHz contact.
sounds.method: Exponential pitch sweep into 68 Hz, nonlinear body, damped 731/1837 Hz modes and band-limited noise.

sounds.name: METALLIC STRIKE
sounds.role: Steel presence from 1–6 kHz with a 437 Hz support mode.
sounds.method: Seven inharmonic exponentially damped modes with frequency-dependent decay, contact noise and a secondary rattle.

sounds.name: MACHINE TICK
sounds.role: Crisp 2–9 kHz detail; negligible low-frequency energy.
sounds.method: Two filtered contact impulses 7 ms apart, three very short metal modes.

sounds.name: INDUSTRIAL SNARE
sounds.role: Hard 600 Hz–5 kHz piston/clamp accent, no acoustic snare model.
sounds.use: Backbeat or displaced machinery accents; velocity 0.60–0.95.
sounds.method: Band-limited noise clamp, inharmonic 337/829/1543/2711 Hz body, delayed contact burst and saturated envelope.

sounds.name: LOW BOOM
sounds.role: 41–95 Hz weight with 170–600 Hz pressure; rolled-off infrasonics.
sounds.use: Phrase boundaries; allow 2.4 s tail; velocity 0.55–0.85.
sounds.method: Slow falling low modes, saturated harmonics, low-passed pressure noise, 28 Hz high-pass.

sounds.name: CINEMATIC IMPACT
sounds.role: Broadband transient, 62 Hz mass, 400 Hz–6 kHz debris and spatial tail.
sounds.use: Major edit points; leave space at onset; velocity 0.65–0.95.
sounds.method: Layered body, seven metal modes, noise blast and deterministic asymmetric multitap reflections; dry low end remains centered.

sounds.name: TENSION RISER
sounds.role: Rising 220–1760 Hz pressure and opening 500 Hz–8 kHz air.
sounds.use: Two bars at 120 BPM, ending exactly at the edit; velocity 0.55–0.90.
sounds.method: Integrated exponential pitch sweep with restrained FM, accelerating amplitude modulation and moving noise cutoff; 8 ms endpoint fade.

sounds.name: REVERSE SWELL
sounds.role: Mid/high suction with restrained 190 Hz support, complementary to bass impacts.
sounds.use: One bar at 120 BPM; start 2 s before target; velocity 0.45–0.80.
sounds.method: Reversed damped inharmonic metal and colored noise, stereo reflections before reversal; 6 ms endpoint taper.

sounds.name: DARK DRONE
sounds.role: 110–900 Hz orbital machinery with restrained 2 kHz friction, not pure sub.
sounds.use: Underlay at velocity 0.40–0.75; overlap every 7 s for longer beds; non-looping.
sounds.method: Detuned harmonic and inharmonic oscillators, slow independent AM/FM, filtered turbulence and decorrelated reflections; 0.8/1.2 s fades.

sounds.name: AIR / NOISE TEXTURE
sounds.role: Soft 900 Hz–7 kHz atmosphere and width, low end removed.
sounds.use: Atmospheric bed at velocity 0.35–0.70; overlap every 7 s; non-looping.
sounds.method: Independent seeded band-limited noise streams, slow multirate amplitude motion, faint upper resonances and 1/1.5 s fades.

sounds.name: ALARM / ENERGY PULSE
sounds.role: D4/A-flat4 tension with 1–3 kHz motor harmonics; no laser sweep.
sounds.use: Three-part motif at 120 BPM; repeat every 1–2 s; velocity 0.45–0.85.
sounds.method: Three unequal 250 ms-spaced amplitude gates, fixed tritone carriers, low-index FM and filtered mechanical noise.
